script_line: Good morning. Six months, one shop, one story: Noor Electronics made PKR 8558310 in net revenue.
Q2 was PKR 5164520, up 52.18 percent on Q1 — but that growth was bought, not earned.
April and May discounts cost PKR 645700, and margin fell from 38.14 percent to 30.53 percent.
May was the peak at PKR 2020840, then June fell 13.71 percent when the promo ended.
Online leads with 41.13 percent of revenue; Stationery is just 2.82 percent.
So: repeat the promo only with a 35 percent margin floor and a 20 percent discount cap.
Put the next ad spend behind Online, and bundle the Notebook Set or review the range.
That is the half in sixty seconds: growth bought on discount, margin down, Online leading.
